messages:
Diego: hey everyone, Diego here — first day on product eng. quick blocker: I can't access the Console CLI or the admin panel on staging. console web works for me read-only but when I try `rwd console login --env=staging` it errors with '403: insufficient entitlements'. who owns CLI entitlements and FF reviewer access? my okta is diego+prod@redwood.ai :wave:
Priya: welcome Diego! I handle new hire onboarding for product. CLI access is gated by the 'console-cli' okta group; feature-flag reviewer is a separate entitlement. we usually give CLI + staging-ff-reviewer for the first 30 days. i'll loop in Rakesh from infra to create a short-lived service token if needed.
Rakesh: hey Diego, saw the CLI error in logs — your account hit the deny rule because you're not in `console-cli-staging` group. i'll open a ticket but need manager approval. Priya can you approve? Also, are you on VPN? CLI needs to fetch a session from the control plane.
Diego: i'm on VPN (macbook, monterey). manager is Priya. a short lived service token would help while approvals are pending — i'll use it only for smoke tests.
Priya: approved. reason: onboarding + verify feature rollout telemetry. please add a note in the onboarding doc: /handbook/onboarding/product/diego.
Sophie: heads up — feature flag reviewer still requires the 'ff-reviewer' checkbox in the security training. Diego, you should be auto-enrolled in the training queue; finish the module and then post here so Rakesh can finalize entitlements. Also we'll need you to sign the rollout ack for any flag flips.
infra-bot: INFRA-3917 created by Rakesh for diego+prod@redwood.ai to add console-cli-staging group membership (duration: 30 days).
okta-bot: OKTA-9145 provision request created. Security training status: pending for diego+prod@redwood.ai.
Rakesh: provisioning a one-time token now for smoke runs, expires in 4 hours: TOKEN_SNIPPED (paste in your local env as RWD_TEMP_TOKEN). use `rwd console login --token $RWD_TEMP_TOKEN --env=staging`. audit will show 'onboard/diego/first-day'.
Diego: token worked, I can list routes and open the admin panel via CLI. saw the flags list with `rwd flags list --env=staging`. will not flip anything in prod.
Sophie: great — once you finish the training i'll add ff-reviewer in staging. reminder: if you test traffic-sensitive flags, use the canary service account and increase sampling to 1% only. docs: https://intra.redwood/ops/flags/playbook.
Diego: finishing the training now. thanks all! will update when done. :raised_hands:
Priya: welcome again Diego! tagging this thread in your onboarding checklist. reach out if you need a walkthrough of the rollout/monitoring dashboards later today.
